clusters.headline: Beta-lactam resistance cluster dominated by Escherichia coli
clusters.observation: This cluster contains 8779 genes, led by beta-lactamase TEM (186), class A carbapenemase KPC (178). The species breakdown is dominated by Escherichia coli (3827), with lab-measured phenotypes reported as 4070 Resistant and 3166 Susceptible. The phenotype split matches the corpus base rate, so this cluster does not distinguish resistant from susceptible isolates.

clusters.headline: Efflux and transport cluster dominated by Escherichia coli
clusters.observation: This cluster contains 5585 genes, led by multidrug efflux RND transporter AcrB (143), Uncharacterized MFS-type transporter (98). The species breakdown is dominated by Escherichia coli (2341), with lab-measured phenotypes reported as 3659 Resistant and 879 Susceptible. This cluster does depart from the corpus base rate (deviation 0.546), so the phenotype split is worth investigating, though co-occurrence is not linkage and not causation.
